def route(signal):
    kind = signal["kind"]
    layer = LAYER_OF.get(kind, "triage")
    return {"id": signal["id"], "layer": layer, "owner": OWNER_OF[layer]}


def priority(sev, recurrence):
    return sev * recurrence


def classify_command(cmd, limit_s):
    try:

        return "failed" if p.returncode else "ok"

brief(outcome_met, guardrail_ok, review_minutes, review_budget, cost_per_task, cost_ceiling):

    if not outcome_met:
        why.append("outcome target not met")
    if review_minutes > review_budget:
        why.append("human review effort above budget")
    if cost_per_task > cost_ceiling:
        why.append("cost above ceiling")
    if not why:
        return "continue", ["outcome met inside review and cost limits"]
    return ("change" if len(why) < 3 else "stop"), why


def effect(before, after):
    return statistics.mean(before), statistics.mean(after), round(100 * (statistics.mean(after) - statistics.mean(before)) / statistics.mean(before), 1)


def control_decision(recurrence_last_90d, replaced_by_stronger, still_blocking_real_failures):
    if replaced_by_stronger and recurrence_last_90d == 0:
        return "retire"
    if still_blocking_real_failures:
        return "keep"
    if recurrence_last_90d == 0:
        return "keep (no replacement, silence is not proof)"
    return "revise"


def within_budget(days_used, budget_days, cost_used, budget_cost):
    return days_used <= budget_days and cost_used <= budget_cost"}},{"type":"code","data":{"filename":"fb_3.py","headingEn":"main(): five experiments","headingKn":"main(): ಐದು ಪ್ರಯೋಗಗಳು","descEn":"main() evaluates five briefs, compares two weekly series with their caveat, decides four controls, checks four budget cases and labels four claims by evidence type.","descKn":"main() ಐದು ವರದಿ ಮೌಲ್ಯಮಾಪನ ಮಾಡಿ, ಎರಡು ವಾರದ ಸರಣಿ ಅವುಗಳ ಎಚ್ಚರಿಕೆಯೊಂದಿಗೆ ಹೋಲಿಸಿ, ನಾಲ್ಕು ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣ ನಿರ್ಧರಿಸಿ, ನಾಲ್ಕು ಬಜೆಟ್ ಸಂದರ್ಭ ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಿ ಮತ್ತು ನಾಲ್ಕು ಹೇಳಿಕೆಗಳನ್ನು ಸಾಕ್ಷ್ಯ ವಿಧದಿಂದ ಲೇಬಲ್ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ.","code":"def main():

brief(outcome_met, guardrail_ok, review_minutes, review_budget, cost_per_task, cost_ceiling):
    why = []
    if not guardrail_ok:
        return "stop", ["guardrail breached"]
    if not outcome_met:
        why.append("outcome target not met")
    if review_minutes > review_budget:
        why.append("human review effort above budget")
    if cost_per_task > cost_ceiling:
        why.append("cost above ceiling")
    if not why:
        return "continue", ["outcome met inside review and cost limits"]
    return ("change" if len(why) < 3 else "stop"), why


def effect(before, after):
    return statistics.mean(before), statistics.mean(after), round(100 * (statistics.mean(after) - statistics.mean(before)) / statistics.mean(before), 1)


def control_decision(recurrence_last_90d, replaced_by_stronger, still_blocking_real_failures):
    if replaced_by_stronger and recurrence_last_90d == 0:
        return "retire"
    if still_blocking_real_failures:
        return "keep"
    if recurrence_last_90d == 0:
        return "keep (no replacement, silence is not proof)"
    return "revise"
